name: Jonathan
bio: Jonathan son of Asahel is named, along with Jahaziah son of Tikvah, in connection with the months-long process of identifying every Israelite who had married a foreign wife; the Hebrew text is ambiguous as to whether the two opposed this process or were put in charge of carrying it out, while Meshullam and Shabbethai the Levite are said to have assisted them (Ezra 10:15-17).
